snippet.title: Mixtape – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Mixtape launches for Nintendo Switch 2 on May 7, 2026!

Three friends, one night, and one last adventure, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

Unfolding through a series of fantastical narrative vignettes, it’s the greatest hits of the teenage experience, from the first kiss to the last dance.

From Beethoven & Dinosaur, developers of BAFTA award-winning game The Artful Escape, Mixtape draws inspiration from classic coming-of-age movies, bringing together nostalgic aimlessness, mischief, music, the highs and lows of adolescence, and the bittersweet feelings brought about by growth, transformation, and moving on.

Featuring iconic tracks from DEVO, Roxy Music, Lush, The Smashing Pumpkins, Iggy Pop, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Joy Division, The Cure, and many more.

#IndieWorld #Mixtape #NintendoSwitch2
